depicted_variant: Grave benevolent sea daughter emerges through breaking Atlantic surf, with irregular body scales, large leg fins and cloven goat hooves.

visual_requirements.description: Woman upper body, scales waist down, two goat-shaped feet, fins along legs
Leaves water and brings good fortune; no destructive magic

aura: Distinct two scaled finned legs/goat feet c02 and active shoreline emergence c03 create benevolent awe, no aura.
artistic_choices: Benevolent grave gaze, weathered adult face and practical opaque high-neck long-sleeved top; no glamour makeup or sexualized pose.
Large ragged fins and irregular thick body scales emphasize documented anatomy c02 at thumbnail size; two cloven goat hooves enlarged by close perspective, not giant scale.

Breaking waves are ordinary sea conditions around her emergence c03, not controlled or generated by her. No kelp is added because it is not in the claims. Moonlit dark basalt coast is editorial context.
prompt: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Mulher Marinha, a benevolent Portuguese sea daughter emerging from the Atlantic. ANATOMY: ONE fully ADULT woman, ONE head, two natural eyes, TWO human arms, one torso fully dressed in plain OPAQUE HIGH-NECK LONG-SLEEVED dark sea-green top. From WAIST DOWN her own body is covered in IRREGULAR THICK OVERLAPPING SILVER-GREEN FISH SCALES, raised and rough, organic flesh scales not leggings, not scale-print costume. Exactly TWO SEPARATE LEGS ending in TWO LARGE CLOVEN GOAT HOOVES, each hoof with two dark horn halves and a deep central split. Large RAGGED TRANSLUCENT FINS run along the OUTER side of each leg, from thigh to calf; both fins conspicuous as broad jagged fans projecting outward. No fish tail, horns, wings, extra limbs or jewelry [mulher-marinha-c01,c02]. MOMENT: RISE FROM THE SEA itself and plant two goat hooves powerfully on low black basalt before the viewer. A natural breaking WAVE towers immediately behind and above her shoulders, its white water pouring from hair, top and scales. One hand opens palm forward in grave benevolent greeting, other extended low to steady herself, five fingers on each hand. Face is GRAVE AND OTHERWORLDLY, mature weathered features with salt and water, severe cheekbones, shut mouth, steady direct EYE CONTACT WITH VIEWER. No makeup, glamour smile, dreamy look, parted-lip model face or fashionable pose. Heavy dark wet hair clings to face and shoulders, not salon waves. POWER: leaves water and brings fortune, benevolent presence only; the sea wave is ordinary physical surf, NOT a wave controlled by magic, no destructive attack or aura [c03]. SCALE & CAMERA: VERY LOW CLOSE camera near black basalt; FULL FIGURE from two big foreground goat hooves to head fills square. The two scaled legs, broad jagged translucent side fins, and distinctly cloven bare hooves must read instantly at 200 pixels. Hooves are NOT boots. Normal human size, large only by close perspective. LIGHT & WEATHER: DARK MOONLIT ATLANTIC NIGHT with one hard shaft of cold moonlight through storm-cloud gap striking wet scales, face, both fins and hoof splits; flying white surf against deep black-green water, strong contrast. NO visible moon disc, no sun disc, no orange sunset sky, no beach postcard. SURFACE: rough wet organic scales, thin jagged fin membranes with ribs, ridged bare goat horn hooves, salt-crusted woven top, coarse wet hair, rough black basalt. SETTING: rocky Atlantic sea shore as she emerges from water [c03]. MOOD: solemn compassionate supernatural awe, powerful daughter of sea, never evil or threatening, never pretty fashion portrait or mermaid costume. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, letters, logo, border, frame, watermark; no extra heads, limbs or digits; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic designs; fully opaque top and body scales, no nudity or gore; no aura, neon, runes or energy ribbons. Square premium painterly cinematic brushwork.
